analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 4 consecutive trading days. RSI attempts to enter oversold territory from 24.6 to 29.4, but MACD histogram continues to worsen at -52676.9654. ADX at 26.3 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI is dominant over +DI (-DI 42.5 vs +DI 16.5), suggesting downward pressure. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.70 times the 5-day average, lacking conviction for directional confirmation.
